question: Becquerel, which is equal to one disintegration per second (dps) is represented by which symbol?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1) Bq**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Becquerel (Bq)** is the SI unit for measuring radioactivity.
 
• It is defined as one disintegration per second.
 
• The unit is named after the French physicist **Henri Becquerel**, who discovered radioactivity in 1896.
 
• Becquerel is widely used in fields such as nuclear medicine and radiology.
 
• The symbol for Becquerel is **Bq**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Radioactivity**:

 
 
• Radioactivity is the process by which unstable atomic nuclei lose energy by emitting radiation.
 
 
 
• **Curie (Ci)**:
 
 
• The Curie, symbolized as Ci, is a non-SI unit of radioactivity, where 1 Ci = 3.7 x 10¹⁰ disintegrations per second.
 
 
 
• **Gray (Gy)**:
 
 
• The Gray, symbolized as Gy, is the SI unit of absorbed radiation dose, where 1 Gy = 1 joule of radiation energy absorbed per kilogram of matter.
 
 
 
• **Sievert (Sv)**:
 
 
• The Sievert, symbolized as Sv, is the SI unit used to measure the health effect of ionizing radiation, where 1 Sv represents a significant biological effect.
